paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure
caption: : XMoE Routing Policy
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the validation performance, measured in Bits Per Character (BPC), of two models—XMoE and SimSMoE—over the course of training, with the x-axis representing training steps in units of thousands (×10³) and the y-axis representing BPC on a linear scale ranging from 1.25 to 2.25. The x-axis spans from 0 to 50 (×10³), with tick marks at intervals of 10 (×10³), while the y-axis has tick marks at intervals of 0.25. The XMoE model is represented by a yellow line with star markers, and the SimSMoE model is represented by a magenta line with star markers; both lines are solid. At the beginning of training (0 ×10³ steps), both models start with a BPC of approximately 2.25. As training progresses, both models exhibit a steep decline in BPC, with SimSMoE slightly outperforming XMoE in the initial phase. By 20 ×10³ steps, both models have converged to a BPC of approximately 1.25, and from 20 ×10³ to 50 ×10³ steps, both lines remain nearly flat, indicating stable performance with BPC values hovering around 1.20 to 1.25. The plot demonstrates that both models achieve similar low BPC values during validation, with SimSMoE showing a marginally better performance throughout the training process.
